name: Fate is not a line
detailed_description:
In Short

"Fate is not a line" is a visual novel game and narrative-driven game where gameplay focuses on making meaningful choices that shape the story. With over 40 decision points, your choices influence character fates, unlock new paths, and lead to one of 25+ unique endings.

The game is highly replayable, featuring branching storylines, multiple playable characters, and the Rashomon effect—where each character’s perspective adds new layers to the narrative. While there are no traditional action or puzzle mechanics, the focus is on immersion, decision-making, and emotional engagement, making it perfect for fans of story-rich, choice-driven visual novel games.

Story

In the depths of time, there was a demon who sought to alter his fate... His name long forgotten. A prideful demon, convinced that his power could conquer all. But it was his arrogance that led to his sealing bound within a chain. And that chain, they say, is the Arbiter of Fate. The Binder of Souls. A relic, cast from east to west throughout history. Now, it has resurfaced. And I shall tell you the tale of four souls who dare to defy destiny... A fool who bargains with the Devil. A pair of eyes that have seen too much. A needle striving to be a sword. And a hanged man. Sit. For I have only just begun. And already, I must tell you this:

Fate is not a line.

Features

  • Branching Storylines: Take control of the narrative with over 40 meaningful choices that allow you to guide the story in the direction you desire. Each decision impacts the characters, relationships, and the world around you.

  • 25+ Unique Endings: Your choices lead to vastly different conclusions, with over 25 distinct endings. Each ending carries its own emotional weight and narrative significance, ensuring no two playthroughs are the same.

  • Four Playable Characters: Experience the story through the eyes of four protagonists:

    • The Fool: A reckless soul who bargains with the Devil.

    • The Seer: A pair of eyes that have seen too much.

    • The Warrior: A needle striving to become a sword.

    • The Hanged Man: A mysterious figure with a tragic past.
      Each character offers a unique perspective, adding depth and complexity to the narrative.

  • Rashomon Effect: Discover the truth—or lack thereof—through multiple perspectives. Each character’s version of events challenges your understanding of the story, making the truth subjective and ever-elusive.

  • Dynamic Consequences: Every choice you make ripples through the story, altering relationships, unlocking new paths, and shaping the world around you. Your decisions have lasting impacts, both seen and unseen.

  • Moral Dilemmas: Face tough choices where there are no clear right or wrong answers. Each decision forces you to weigh the consequences, testing your morals and convictions.

  • Atmospheric Music: Immerse yourself in a hauntingly beautiful soundtrack that enhances the tension, melancholy, and mystery of every scene.

  • Deep Narrative: Dive into a rich, dark fantasy story with over 6,000 words of compelling dialogue and lore. Explore themes of fate, deception, and consequence as you uncover the secrets of the Arbiter of Fate—a powerful relic that binds souls and alters destinies.

  • Replayability: With countless branching paths, hidden secrets, and multiple endings, "Fate is not a line" invites you to play again and again to uncover every possibility. Each playthrough reveals new layers of the story, ensuring a fresh experience every time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 1.8GHz Dual-Core CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains moderate depictions of gore, grotesque injuries, and deaths. While these elements are presented in a dark fantasy setting, they are designed to enhance the atmosphere and storytelling rather than for shock value. Players may encounter unsettling visuals and descriptions, but they are not excessively graphic or gratuitous. Viewer discretion is advised.
